text_block_list.name: Epi & Golshi
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"W-What incredible spirit...!"
"Both of them are so powerful...!"
"Go get 'em, Epi-san!"
(Uwooooooah!!)
choice_data_list: (Wow, the crowd is really fired up...!)

text_block_list.text:
The arena was in a frenzy over their fierce clash.
The Umamusume who came to watch seemed to admire Epiphaneia even more, but—

text_block_list.name: Ribbon-Wearing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aaah... That was insane.
I don't know when I'll be able to debut, but... I'm gonna run just like Epi-san!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...She's shaking her head.
Which means...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I was strong today, too. I ran brilliantly like the sun, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
......No, that's not wrong. I'm the one
who can awaken everyone's voice!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'll give everyone conviction and make them happy!!
Isn't that right, Voice?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Yooo.
Epi-san, my pal."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Your yellowtail
was crazy fresh.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...But—
no one's voice has awakened."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's not waking up at all.
...Am I doing something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but...
that fierce spark in your eyes—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Instead of sparkly and flashy, isn't it more like... swooshing through the galaxy?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
What's that supposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's the gist of it.
Welp, see you in the mountains next time~

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I see, as expected... none of their voices have awakened yet.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine!!
Let's pick our next goal race!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The excitement today was incredible!
In that case, all we have to do is surpass it again!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: How about it, Trainer! Which race do you think is worthy of me?!

If we are to challenge a prestigious, high-profile GⅠ race like this...
the one that comes to mind is that traditional, storied race
held in the autumn—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!! That's awesome, and plus...
It's the race Kris S won back-to-back!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I can show a radiance at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) that surpasses today...
I can wake that voice up this time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right!?
...
choice_data_list: Is that what the voice of destiny is telling you too?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...That is...

Epiphaneia's eyebrows furrowed with worry.
Her, who always overflowed with absolute confidence.
...Could some kind of change be taking place?
choice_data_list: ...Epi, how about we go for a walk once you get changed?

text_block_list.text:
Until now, she has always spoken her mind honestly.
The fact that she can't must mean she's utterly confused.
If so, then—
choice_data_list: (I'll wait until she finds the right words.)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!
The wind is blowing right through me...!

After wandering aimlessly from the racetrack, we found a large open square. There's no one around right now.
Side by side, we quietly gaze at the scenery—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's meeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I am the sun!!!!
That's why I'm the one who'll do it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Right!?!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
……Ugh, it's no good.
I can't hear anything……

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I can't hear it. The voice of destiny...
It won't validate me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Why!?
You've been cheering me on this whole time, haven't you?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And yet... why can't I hear it?
—Why did you speak with my voice!?
choice_data_list: Hold on, Epi. Does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...Lately, the voice of destiny has been acting strange.
Until now, I could hear a mystical voice, but—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, it became my exact voice!
And as of today—it completely vanished!!

The reason she was always so full of confidence was because she could hear that mysterious voice of destiny.
Yet now, she says she can no longer hear it.
On top of that, it seems the voice of destiny has recently begun overlapping with her own voice. Speaking of changes that have happened to her lately—
choice_data_list: (The frustration of not being able to awaken that voice...)

text_block_list.text:
"Even when she gets results, no voice awakens within the other girls.
Her confidence in her dream is currently wavering."
Could it be that the Voice of Destiny is linked to the changes in her heart?
choice_data_list: (If so, is the voice of destiny truly...?)

text_block_list.text:
"...I hesitated on whether I should share my guess with her.
It risked shaking the very foundation of what she believed in.
Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
You noticed something, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Name anything!! I'll do whatever it takes to get my voice back...!"
choice_data_list: ...Maybe it's impossible to take it back.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: Because it's something you still have inside you.
Because it's something you still carry within you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: The voice of destiny is... probably your own voice.
The voice of destiny is... probably your own voice.

text_block_list.text:
Precisely because the voice of destiny was Epiphaneia's own voice...
perhaps it disappeared once her self-confidence began to waver.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"......No.
There's no way."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Because the voice of destiny has been by my side ever since I can remember...
giving me a push forward."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because I can hear the voice of destiny,
that makes me special.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Because there is an absolute blessing!
That's how I... made it this far...!"

Her inner turmoil was evident. Even so,
the fact she couldn't fully deny it... meant she might have
something in mind herself.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...If the voice of destiny is truly...
nothing more than my own voice..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Is the idea that destiny loves me
also mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, there's no way!
Destiny is on my side...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're right, aren't you, my voice?!
Please, back me up here...!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Of course it is.
Destiny's got a crush on me!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...Nghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I won't accept this...!!

Epiphaneia took off as if shaking off a nightmare,
her figure growing further and further away—until she disappeared from sight.
